ai_summary: **Executive Summary:**  Astra Microwave Products Limited has submitted a routine compliance certificate under SEBI Regulation 74(5) for the quarter ended September 30, 2026. The certificate, issued by their Registrar and Share Transfer Agent, confirms all shareholder requests for dematerialization of securities were processed correctly and finalized within prescribed timelines. This indicates strong corporate governance and regulatory adherence regarding shareholder services, with no material impacts or red flags identified.
